_comment: Recording-rig DATA for the existing September exports - not code, and
not a camera-make assumption (requirement 6): the keys are the
RECORDING's camera folder names as written by the bag exporter.
camera_heights_m: calibrated camera heights over ground [m] fitted
against the KISS-ICP scale on the September recordings (the monocular
scale anchor). A kart_master.cfg [camera] height_m always overrides.
camera_links: the September rigs' TF link names - a compatibility
fallback used only when a recording's camera_info.json carries no
'link' entry and no TF frame contains the camera name.
For a NEW camera nothing here is consulted: heights come from the cfg
(README.md 'Calibrating the camera height') and links from TF.
